ai.title: AI assistant
ai.description: Lets admins and finance staff ask questions about club operations. Answers come only from your club's own records.
ai.toggleLabel: Enable the AI assistant for this club
ai.unconfigured: The AI assistant is not available on this platform yet.

addon.notIncluded: The AI assistant is a paid add-on and is not included in your plan.

addon.complimentary: Your club has the AI assistant add-on free of charge.
addon.paid: Your club has the AI assistant as a paid add-on.

ai.processingNotice: When it is on, questions and a minimal summary of your club's records are processed by an AI sub-processor on the club's behalf. Your data is not used to train AI models. Medical notes and payment-card details are never sent.
ai.whoCanUse: Available to club admins and finance staff.
ai.auditNote: Every change is recorded in the audit log.

actions.cancelDraftConfirm: This draft was never sent. It will be marked cancelled; nothing is deleted.
actions.cancelIssuedConfirm: A cancellation document for {amount} is issued against this invoice. Nothing is deleted and you can reopen it later.
actions.reopenConfirm: The cancellation is voided and the invoice is open again with its original amount and payment reference.
actions.writeOffConfirm: The open balance of {amount} will be written off as uncollectable. You can reverse it if the money arrives later.

invoice.draftHint: This draft has not been sent yet, so every field can be changed.
invoice.issuedHint: This invoice has been issued. You can change the due date, notes, language and reminders here. To change the amount, issue a credit or debit note so the original stays on record.
invoice.notesHint: Shown to the family on the invoice.
invoice.negativeLineHint: A negative unit price adds a discount line.
invoice.saveDraftConfirm: Save the draft with a total of {amount}?
invoice.remindersPaused: Pause payment reminders for this invoice

adjust.title: Adjust invoice {number}
adjust.hint: The issued invoice is not changed. A credit note lowers the amount due, a debit note raises it; both are numbered and shown to the family.
adjust.voidConfirm: The document stays on record as voided and the amount due changes back by {amount}.

payment.recordOverConfirm: {amount} is more than the open balance of {balance}. The excess will be flagged as an overpayment. Record it?
payment.editHint: Saving voids the original payment and records the corrected one. Both stay on record.
payment.reallocatedMessage: Payment moved to the other invoice
payment.noTargets: No other open invoice in this currency.
payment.voidConfirm: A reversing entry of {amount} is added. The original payment stays on record as voided.
payment.stripeLocked: Online (Stripe) payments cannot be changed here; refunds are made in Stripe. You can add an internal note.
payment.settledNote: Nothing is outstanding. A further payment will be flagged as an overpayment.
payment.pageHint: Online payments update only from verified Stripe webhooks. Manual payments can be corrected, moved or voided with a reason.

overpay.hint: move the excess to the family's credit to use it on a later invoice.
overpay.parentNote: You paid {amount} more than due. The club will credit it to your account.

credit.title: Family credit
credit.applyConfirm: Pay {amount} of invoice {number} from the family's credit?
credit.adjustHint: Current balance {balance}. A positive amount adds credit (goodwill); a negative amount records credit paid out. The balance cannot go below zero.
credit.familyBalancesHint: Money held for families, for example from overpayments. It can pay later invoices.

training.pageHint: Credit packages, balances and every change with its reason.

errors.generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.
errors.NOT_AUTHORIZED: Only club admins and finance can do this.
errors.INVOICE_NOT_DRAFT: Only drafts can be edited freely. Issue a credit or debit note instead.
errors.INVOICE_IS_DRAFT: This is still a draft: edit it directly instead.
errors.INVOICE_WRITTEN_OFF: This invoice is written off. Reverse the write-off first.
errors.INVOICE_LOCKED: This invoice can no longer be changed.
errors.CREDIT_EXCEEDS_AMOUNT_DUE: A credit note cannot be larger than the amount due.
errors.USE_CANCEL: Crediting the whole unpaid amount is a cancellation: use Cancel invoice.
errors.NOTHING_TO_WRITE_OFF: There is no open balance to write off.
errors.INVALID_AMOUNT: Enter an amount greater than zero.
errors.INVALID_TOTAL: The total cannot be negative, and every line needs a quantity above zero.
errors.INVALID_QUANTITY: Quantities must be greater than zero.
errors.INVALID_TAX_RATE: The tax rate must be between 0 and 100.
errors.INVALID_LOCALE: Choose one of the offered languages.
errors.NO_ITEMS: Add at least one line item.
errors.CANNOT_CANCEL: Paid or written-off invoices cannot be cancelled. Refund or issue a credit note instead.
errors.HAS_PAYMENTS: This invoice has payments. Void or move them first.
errors.NOT_CANCELLED: Only cancelled invoices can be reopened.
errors.WAS_PAID: This invoice received money and cannot be reopened.
errors.USE_REOPEN: Use Reopen to undo a cancellation.
errors.INVALID_DATE: The payment date cannot be in the future.
errors.STRIPE_PAYMENT_LOCKED: Online (Stripe) payments cannot be changed here. Refund in Stripe.
errors.NOT_EDITABLE: This payment cannot be edited; void it instead.
errors.CURRENCY_MISMATCH: The other invoice is in a different currency.
errors.CREDIT_ALREADY_USED: The credit from this payment has already been used.
errors.AMOUNT_EXCEEDS_OVERPAYMENT: The amount is larger than the overpayment.
errors.INVOICE_NOT_PAYABLE: This invoice cannot be paid from credit.
errors.NOTHING_DUE: Nothing is outstanding on this invoice.
errors.NO_CREDIT: This family has no credit in this currency.
errors.AMOUNT_TOO_HIGH: The amount is larger than the credit or the open balance.
errors.CREDIT_NEGATIVE: The family credit cannot go below zero.
errors.INVALID_CREDITS: Enter a whole number of credits.
errors.BELOW_USED: The total cannot be lower than the credits already used.
errors.TAX_LOCKED: Tax and currency cannot change once payments exist.
errors.REMINDERS_PAUSED: Reminders are paused for this invoice.
